text: make sure you cover this: so there are far obvious reasons to keep it, like, start with a model, tint out the existing soup, and then be able to toggle the tint at the same positions so you can come back at the end and see the entire mesh as a ghost of its former self ontop of the current, shows how much it follows
resolution: Added a frozen retopology source-ghost layer alongside the live tint map. The first manual tint snapshots the original resident triangle positions and source labels; tinting can complete that source map until the first topology generation change, after which the before-image is immutable while live labels continue following delete, weld, and replacement edits. A new Eye control and Agent Seat ghost operation toggle the colored original soup over the normal current mesh, report coverage, and clear with the existing X or a model load. Added native generation/domain guards, Zig and Seat regressions, updated the Agent Seat skill, and completed a ReleaseFast editor build. User visual comparison and the required 60-second ghost-on spikewatch remain the review gate.
